g.title: j1887050668
g.text: Have you thought any more about my argument regarding your "Indifference?"

g.title: j4224182894->j1887050668
g.text: RoatheMITW4

g.title: j1822896911
g.text: I have. I think what Entrati let loose from the Void was a shapeless god that was there in the aether before we arrived.

g.title: j2142372200
g.text: I have. I think you're full of shit.

g.title: j3529829331
g.text: I have. I think you're right. I don't think it existed before Entrati interacted with it. He wanted to find a god... so the Void spat something out that's pretending to be one.

g.title: j2225943748
g.text: I have. I think the answer is somewhere in between. It may not have been a god before, but it is now. I think Entrati blinked it into existence the moment he opened the Void.

g.title: j1871376390
g.text: It simply cannot understand what we are.

g.title: j4099310853
g.text: Check boolean RoatheDating

g.title: j1895394034
g.text: And we've been feeding it fear ever since.

g.title: j171258716
g.text: Like how Rell both Exists and Doesn't now, the Indifference is never was a god, yet now, always has been.

g.title: j1951131102
g.text: Can I convince you to consider my position once more? Or are your views on the the topic immutable?

g.title: j1786253278
g.text: I would not have expected you to have such a delicate trigger, Drifter darling. But to quote the zealots, "c'est la vie."

g.title: j4099310853->j1786253278
g.text: true

g.title: j1746643871
g.text: To quote the zealots, "c'est la vie."

g.title: j4099310853->j1746643871

g.title: j2479268686
g.text: Boolean DrifterMITWNotGod is now true.

g.title: j842971152
g.text: I hate you Eternalism types. You use it as an excuse for everything. Once an Archimedean thinks they wrap their heads around it, off they go.

g.title: j622695256
g.text: You can try.

g.title: j3356661263
g.text: No use.

g.title: j650387292
g.text: Boolean RoatheNoDate is now true.

g.title: j978907978
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1287722398
g.text: "I didn't forget to water your office plant like I promised, it's simply experiencing a different Eternalism branch parallel to ours."

g.title: j2306781812
g.text: While you do not sound terribly philosophical today but I will give it a go, nonetheless.

g.title: j776748929
g.text: Boolean RoatheDating is now false.

g.title: j3126395200
g.text: Glorious! Finally, progress is made. Sound the trumpets, ring the bells, someone finally sees sense!

g.title: j3067174232
g.text: It makes me want to scream. Can you simply commit to something for once in your miserable lives?!

g.title: j157377535
g.text: It is not as though I have anything better to be doing with my time.

g.title: j178902881
g.text: Boolean IsDating is now false.

g.title: j4290145
g.text: Check boolean RoatheDating

g.title: j822491263
g.text: What I am trying to say, is that it wasn't a god before, but it is one now.

g.title: j786507426
g.text: Never mind.

g.title: j2381878288
g.text: Let us begin at the top, shall we? How would you define what a "god" is?

g.title: j3796152741
g.text: Though I had no doubt you would come around, Drifter darling. you already had shown to be of discerning taste already.

g.title: j4290145->j3796152741
g.text: true

g.title: j3650933134
g.text: Though I had no doubt you would come around, Drifter. I am quite convincing.

g.title: j4290145->j3650933134
g.text: false

g.title: j845672935
g.text: I see. It was fashioned into a "god" from the Void by Albrecht. And now we have a "god" on the loose. How charming.

g.title: j935861405
g.text: Indeed.

g.title: j920126219
g.text: A supreme being. Something that has total and unquestionable authority or power.

g.title: j3355442947
g.text: A superhuman entity or creature that has power over a particular aspect of creation or human fortune.

g.title: j59203246
g.text: I'm not sure. You go first.

g.title: j375630423
g.text: Now, if only we could find a way to convince all the other lunatics around the asylum...

g.title: j4268793210
g.text: Correct, yes.

g.title: j1285827072
g.text: Yes, but I think we might be getting caught up on how we're both defining what a "god" is.

g.title: j2789259656
g.text: And you believe that your Indifference is one of these supreme beings?

g.title: j2040275482
g.text: And this Indifference of yours is a supreme entity or creature? And is wields power over an aspect of... Indifference. Of uncaring?

g.title: j1286896356
g.text: Now who is a coward? Very well. Allow me to simplify matters and cut right to the chase:

g.title: j833144731
g.text: What I don't understand, is what good this does us?

g.title: j2305117481
g.text: Why bother?

g.title: j835071117
g.text: Then let me simplify matters and cut right to the chase; Do you believe a "god" can die?

g.title: j2431040356
g.text: A fair point. How would you define a "god?"

g.title: j2743992003
g.text: I don't know.

g.title: j2186025963
g.text: Yes. I believe so.

g.title: j80786278
g.text: Do you believe a "god" can die?

g.title: j3494019696
g.text: What good does it do us? All the good in the world! Of course, you are the one who has always fought alone. You have never been subjected to the tactics of an army.

g.title: j808080305
g.text: Why bother? You poor thing. Of course, you are the one who has always fought alone. You have never been subjected to the tactics of an army.

g.title: j3158630897
g.text: Can a "god," by any means, cease to exist?

g.title: j1832165979
g.text: I'm not sure. You go first.

g.title: j3154797612
g.text: A superhuman entity or creature that has power over a particular aspect of creation or human fortune.

g.title: j411549331
g.text: An entity that is beyond our comprehension. A creature that exists in a dimension outside ours, and, therefore, does not exist "like us."

g.title: j233270360
g.text: Enough of this going about in circles. Allow me to simply cut to the chase:

g.title: j3323216182
g.text: Check boolean RoatheDating

g.title: j500710544
g.text: My hope is to send him back to where he came from.

g.title: j123565785
g.text: I don't know. And I don't think anyone can know.

g.title: j1218786666
g.text: No. I don't think so. Persistence of matter, and all that.

g.title: j3474789502
g.text: Yes, I think so. Otherwise, we'd be overrun, wouldn't we?

g.title: j3326493426
g.text: I sincerely hope so.

g.title: j1309980706
g.text: Knowing thy enemy is key. Now, I have a question for you. Do you believe this creature can be killed?

g.title: j3015513157
g.text: Now who is a coward? Very well. Allow me to simplify matters and cut right to the chase:

g.title: j4046008236
g.text: And this Indifference of yours is a supreme entity or creature? And is wields power over an aspect of... Indifference. Of uncaring?

g.title: j1036783084
g.text: Aaah, I see. Now there's the rub. Yes, our definitions did not match. Insomuch as this "Indifference" is an entity as you describe it? Yes. We are agreed.

g.title: j2156091272
g.text: Disappointing. I would have thought you more clever than that. But allow me to ask you this and cut to the chase:

g.title: j3323216182->j2156091272
g.text: true

g.title: j2488802443
g.text: Disappointing. But allow me to ask you this and cut to the chase:

g.title: j3323216182->j2488802443
g.text: false

g.title: j1739547524
g.text: Peacemongers. Why must there always be a peacemonger.

g.title: j1371107730
g.text: Therefore, you imply in your modest ignorance, that we are all groping about in the darkness.

g.title: j2580463961
g.text: Oh, grand. You think "gods" cannot die!

g.title: j1277893366
g.text: And your logic is... that gods can die because... "gods" are like pobbers?

g.title: j2251111682
g.text: Well, yes, that is obvious, but stick with me, Drifter. I need you to focus.

g.title: j3376704601
g.text: No clue, honestly.

g.title: j1411243414
g.text: Everything can be killed. Even the Indifference. Somehow.

g.title: j205737416
g.text: We might not be able to kill it, but that doesn't mean we can't stop it.

g.title: j2127443513
g.text: Yes. I believe so.

g.title: j2752602915
g.text: I don't know.

g.title: j2105694069
g.text: We simply had a mismatch of shorthand terminology. How amusing.

g.title: j3335747066
g.text: There are only two choices before you. Either you believe this thing can die, and it is therefore not a "god,"

g.title: j2883446565
g.text: If none of us can know if a "god" can die, and this Indifference is one of them, then why do we bother to fight it at all?

g.title: j208922016
g.text: Void on high I think I am dealing with an idiot.

g.title: j1947412635
g.text: Boolean DrifterMITWKillMaybe is now true.

g.title: j1886478789
g.text: Boolean DrifterMITWKill is now true.

g.title: j3366655510
g.text: Boolean DrifterMITWStop is now true.

g.title: j225198368
g.text: Enough of this going about in circles. Allow me to simply cut to the chase: Can a "god", by any means, cease to exist?

g.title: j3376300901
g.text: I suppose "dreadful eldritch horror from beyond our comprehension" is far too many syllables to banter about, to be fair. Allow me to cut to the chase, then:

g.title: j2100011938
g.text: Or you believe it cannot be defeated, and it does not matter what you want to call it, for we are merely waiting to for it to consume us all.

g.title: j2324999473
g.text: I think I am going to slit my throat with my own tail.

g.title: j1660760924
g.text: "Somehow."

g.title: j2603854956
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2068122483
g.text: I have wielded all my best arguments on you, and I have begun to fear they are all for naught. So I shall simply ask you one last time, and I shall pray that sanity shall prevail.

g.title: j3880301946
g.text: No wonder the butler always looks so exhausted. He is always dealing with you.

g.title: j2414525117
g.text: I do hope you are as good at concocting solutions "on the fly" as the others say you are.

g.title: j2042257443
g.text: Hm. Because stuffing its fingers in a jar and then replicating them has gone so well.

g.title: j4050875503
g.text: And I beg you to remember all that I have said to you.

g.title: j1209491111
g.text: Otherwise, it seems we are all operating on a little "faith."

g.title: j693551018
g.text: But perhaps it is not a poor solution.

g.title: j2970612246
g.text: Is the Indifference a "god?"

g.title: j4081414586
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3950949218
g.text: The Indifference is a god and always was.

g.title: j1607942934
g.text: The Indifference is not a god and it never was.

g.title: j3981791290
g.text: The Indifference became a god when Entrati opened the Void.

g.title: j184332308
g.text: I don't know!

g.title: j2510543356
g.text: Somehow, we'll kill it.

g.title: j838124358
